# Chris Frasca Insurance Services

> Chris Frasca is an independent licensed insurance agent (California Insurance License No. 0L86243) who helps people choose and keep Medicare coverage in Orange County and Ventura County, California. He has helped people with Medicare since August 2016. His help costs the client nothing: insurance companies pay agents a commission, and the client's premium is the same whether they enroll through an agent or directly with Medicare. He represents a limited number of insurance organizations and does not offer every plan available in an area. Phone 949-259-6744. Email chris@chrisfrascainsurance.com.

Chris meets clients in person in Orange County and works by phone or video in Orange County and Ventura County. He hosts educational Medicare workshops in Mission Viejo.

- [2027 Medicare changes in California](https://chrisfrascainsurance.com/2027-medicare-changes-california.html): CMS-published 2027 figures and Annual Enrollment dates
- [How to find a local insurance agent for Medicare](https://chrisfrascainsurance.com/find-a-local-insurance-agent-for-medicare.html): what to look for, how to check a California license, HICAP
